description: React component implementing a login page with form validation, server communication, and navigation.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL from environment variables, preferring REACT_APP_API_BASE over REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the login form fields, ensuring username/email and password are provided.

methods.name: parseServerError
methods.description: Attempts to extract a meaningful error message from server response.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, including validation, API call, error handling, and navigation upon success.
